title: 8 Ways a Godly Man Turns Online Friends Into Real Brothers
caption:
A lot of us have more brothers on a screen than in a room. Good guys, real conversations. But a Discord can't sit with you at the hospital and a group chat can't help you move.

The online friend can become the real thing. It just costs a phone call, a date on the calendar, an hour of driving, and one honest sentence about your week. Then keep showing up.

"Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." Proverbs 27:17

Send this to the online friend you've never actually met.
